n01.text:
Start workout starts the workout and opens Focused view. Focused is the default; whichever view was used last is remembered.

The dashed box under the set's source line is reserved for a future suggested weight. It stays empty for now and holds its height so the layout won't jump later.

n02.text:
List view: every exercise on one page. Only the next set of the current exercise is open for input; tap any To do row to log it. Planned values are pre-filled the same way as Focused.

Any exercise's next set can be logged at any time. Tapping a set in another exercise opens it and collapses the open one back to a row; its pre-filled values are kept. The Now marker stays on the last logged set.

n03.text:
Pre-fill rule: the same set number from last time; if there is none, copy the previous set from today.

Weighted: kg + reps (2.5 kg steps). Bodyweight: reps only. Timed hold: seconds (5 s steps). No timer.

Never logged before (weighted): the weight is pre-filled with a starting weight, labelled "Starting weight", not left blank.

n04.text: Tap the pencil on a logged set to edit or delete it. Delete and Skip both confirm first. Extra sets copy the previous set. Skipped exercises can still be logged before Finish.

n05.text:
The workout saves on the phone after every set. Reopening the app shows Today with this banner; Resume reopens the last view. Discard deletes the in-progress workout after a confirm.

A workout left open more than 24 hours is closed and saved as finished. Today shows a one-time notice about it; Dismiss hides it for good.

n06.text: Volume = weight × reps over weighted sets only; bodyweight and timed sets are not counted. Recovering lists the muscles trained today. Done returns to Today.

n07.text: Today after Finish: the Start button is gone, and the pre-workout reason paragraph is removed. The status chips and the completed summary stay. The core finisher counts as an exercise (5 exercises).

n08.text: After the last planned set, the input card is replaced by Exercise complete and the bottom button becomes "Next: <next exercise>". On the final exercise it becomes Finish workout. Add a set and the edit pencils stay available.
